products.name: Mitre core laminations
products.cardLine: 45° mitre-cut CRGO laminations for step-lap transformer cores.

seo.title: Mitre Core & Step-Lap Laminations | MANZZA, Bengaluru
seo.description: Mitre-cut CRGO step-lap laminations for distribution and power transformer cores, made to your drawing by MANZZA Industry in Bengaluru.

products.headline: Mitre core laminations, cut for step-lap.
products.intro: Electrical steel laminations with 45° mitre ends, cut to your drawing and supplied for step-lap stacking. From one layer to the next, the joint position moves by a small step, so neighbouring joints do not line up. This is our flagship product, made for distribution and power transformers.
